title: Part 3 三人對話與說話者意圖
summary: 三個人一起說話，還有「說這句話是什麼意思」的題目。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: Part 3 有時候是三個人的對話，聲音和口音都不一樣（美式、英式都有）。不用記住誰是誰，只要聽懂「誰擔心什麼、誰要做什麼」。
意圖題長這樣：What does the woman mean when she says, "We only have two days"? 要從前後文判斷她的意思：時間太趕了。

steps.title: 解題技巧

head: 題目
中文
怎麼解
rows: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
What is the man worried about?
What does the woman mean when she says "…"?
她說這句話是什麼意思？
What will the woman do next?

steps.tip: 意圖題的答案通常不是字面意思，要想「她為什麼這樣說」。

items.en: I'll start on it this afternoon.

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 先看題目，再按 ▶ 聽對話。每段對話有 3 題。

questions.prompt: 說話者主要在討論什麼？
questions.explanation:
the office is moving to a new building：辦公室要搬家。
逐字稿：W: Hi, Daniel, hi, Tom. Did you hear the office is moving to a new building next month?　M1: Yes. I heard it's near the train station. That will make my trip to work much shorter.　M2: Same for me. But I'm worried about parking. The new building doesn't have a parking lot.　W: Actually, the company is going to give everyone a free monthly train pass.　M2: Really? That's great news.
questions.sentence: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

questions.prompt: 其中一名男子擔心什麼？
questions.explanation:
I'm worried about parking. 新大樓沒有停車場。
逐字稿：W: Hi, Daniel, hi, Tom. Did you hear the office is moving to a new building next month?　M1: Yes. I heard it's near the train station. That will make my trip to work much shorter.　M2: Same for me. But I'm worried about parking. The new building doesn't have a parking lot.　W: Actually, the company is going to give everyone a free monthly train pass.　M2: Really? That's great news.
questions.sentence: What is one of the men worried about?

questions.explanation:
give everyone a free monthly train pass：每個人一張免費的火車月票。
逐字稿：W: Hi, Daniel, hi, Tom. Did you hear the office is moving to a new building next month?　M1: Yes. I heard it's near the train station. That will make my trip to work much shorter.　M2: Same for me. But I'm worried about parking. The new building doesn't have a parking lot.　W: Actually, the company is going to give everyone a free monthly train pass.　M2: Really? That's great news.

questions.prompt: 女子說「我們只有兩天」是什麼意思？
options: She thinks the time is short.
She wants to take two days off.
questions.answer: She thinks the time is short.
questions.explanation:
客戶要在星期五前改好，她說「只有兩天」，意思是時間很趕。
逐字稿：M: Sarah, the client wants to change the design of the brochure by Friday.　W: By Friday? We only have two days.　M: I know. Can you work on it with Ken? I'll ask him to help.　W: OK. I'll start on it this afternoon.
questions.sentence: What does the woman mean when she says, "We only have two days"?

questions.explanation:
I'll ask him（Ken）to help. coworker 是同事。
逐字稿：M: Sarah, the client wants to change the design of the brochure by Friday.　W: By Friday? We only have two days.　M: I know. Can you work on it with Ken? I'll ask him to help.　W: OK. I'll start on it this afternoon.
questions.sentence: What does the man say he will do?

questions.prompt: 女子什麼時候開始做小冊子？
questions.explanation:
I'll start on it this afternoon.
逐字稿：M: Sarah, the client wants to change the design of the brochure by Friday.　W: By Friday? We only have two days.　M: I know. Can you work on it with Ken? I'll ask him to help.　W: OK. I'll start on it this afternoon.
questions.sentence: When will the woman start working on the brochure?

questions.explanation: brochure：介紹產品或服務的小冊子。
